driver: Candidate alarm signals are validated on a labelled corpus at a fixed test level and a cap on false alarms, and the counted events cluster within the units that were randomised, so each ratio's variance has to be built at those units; a test that treats the events as independent understates it severalfold and makes the most sensitive candidate appear to break the false-alarm cap, and a per-unit average of ratios restores a valid variance only by changing the estimand, which dilutes an effect concentrated in heavy units.
driver_concrete: Gap-session rate is gap sessions over all sessions in an arm, and installs, not sessions, are randomised and carry their flaky devices and reading habits across all their sessions, so its variance is the delta-method variance of a ratio of per-install sums; the two-proportion z over sessions understates it about 3.5-fold, holds several clean 2026 experiments and drops the check, and the per-install mean of shares, valid but another estimand, dilutes loss incidents concentrated in heavy readers, so both file the late-session check.
stump: A competent solver tests each session-share check with a two-proportion z over sessions, finds the gap-session check holding several of the 64 clean 2026 experiments, over the one-in-fifty allowance, and files the late-session check, which catches far fewer of the confirmed incidents; the step that lands it there is treating sessions as independent when installs were randomised and their sessions share a device and a reader.

differentiation.task187: task187 measures each turbine's shortfall at its own turbulence spread, so a capped, curved response does not charge a site's eddies to a blade; this build validates data-health checks on a labelled corpus of experiments, and the decisive step is the variance of a ratio metric built at the randomised install (the delta method on per-install sums): no response curve, no spread of inputs, no matching, and the per-install mean of shares is a second wrong route the turbine build has no counterpart for.
differentiation.task229: task229 v1 (spent) built the standard error of a mean exceedance over sites failing together behind a shared network node, for one alert's significance; this build tests ratio metrics whose sessions cluster within installs the platform randomised, through the linearised variance of a ratio of sums, inside metric validation where the understated variance reads as a noisy check breaking a false-hold allowance on clean experiments, and where the per-install average of shares, a valid variance for another estimand, is a further wrong route.
differentiation.task228: architecture 1 (spent) set a paging threshold per monitored run over a season, on how many nights a run is checked and on mid-run revisions (a stratification by a visible attribute); this architecture judges each experiment once on its full run at a filed level, and the decisive step is the field's own variance of a ratio metric at the randomisation unit, with no run length, no revision and no season.

lineage.driver: The false-alarm budget is set per monitored run over the season a setting is live, and a run's chance of a false page carries whatever disturbed the nights it was checked; in the record a third of the long runs took a mid-run configuration change, which makes the per-night candidates jump for about a week and leaves its imbalance in the cumulative one for the rest of the run, and no run can be changed during the season, so a threshold calibrated on every long run in the record over-sets the candidates the changes disturb, and held on the long runs that ran unchanged, the candidate the changes hit hardest takes its most sensitive setting and leads.
lineage.driver_concrete: The peak alert may page no more than one in twenty sound experiments over the season; every peak test books four weeks and none can be revised while it runs (no revision ships in the change freeze), while 60 of last year's 166 sound four-week runs took a revision (a ramp, an audience edit, a copy change) that makes the beacon-loss, late-events and events-per-user checks jump on sound tests for about a week and whose imbalance the cumulative exposure gap carries for the rest of the run; pooled, the beacon-loss check needs 7.5 and the exposure gap leads at 4.5, while held on the 106 runs that ran unrevised the beacon-loss check holds at 3.0 and leads with 22 catches.
lineage.stump: A competent solver takes the replay audit as the record of sound and defective, holds the page budget on last year's sound four-week runs because every 2027 peak test books 28 nights, and wires the exposure-gap check at 4.5 (12 of 78 caught); the step that lands it there is pooling all 166 of those runs, when 60 of them took a revision mid-run and the change freeze lets no revision reach a peak test: a revision makes the beacon-loss check jump on sound tests for a week (57 of the 60 paged at 3.0), which drives its pooled setting to 7.5, so held on the 106 runs that ran unrevised, as every peak test will, the beacon-loss check holds at 3.0 and leads with 22.
lineage.answer: Wire the paging alert to the pageview beacon loss check (beacon_loss_z) at a setting of 3.0 for the whole 2027 peak, 4 January to 28 March 2027.

lineage.architecture: v2 loop 0 (architecture 2 as cut for round 3, before hardening loop 1)
lineage.fate: hardened 2026-10-11: round 3 landed the call on the solver's step 6, plain triple collocation of station, morning retrieval and model; that step is now a lower rung that completes and returns the wrong eight, because the two products share the soil map's texture over the clay plains
lineage.driver: Each unit's own random error against a signal that nothing observes decides the ranking, and every comparison available carries the comparator's own error, which here is largest exactly where units sit in a comparator's weak conditions; three independent measurements of one signal identify each one's error from their pairwise covariances, so ranking units on their disagreement with one comparator, with whichever comparator they match better, or with the comparators' average sends the scarce visits to sound units in the comparators' weak spots.
lineage.driver_concrete: The spring crew can re-install eight of the network's 56 stations, and the network standard ranks stations on their own random error against the true soil moisture of their satellite cell; the retrieval errs most over the parkland and pothole cells and the land-surface model (no irrigation, no ponding) over the irrigation district, the clay plain and the potholes, so a station's unbiased error against either product, the better of the two or their mean carries that product's error, and only triple collocation of station, retrieval and model on their common mornings separates the station's own error.
lineage.stump: A competent solver places each station in its Ninox cell, matches its 5 cm reading at the morning overpass to the recommended-quality morning retrieval, treats the retrieval as the cell's soil moisture, ranks the 56 stations by their unbiased error against it and sends the crew to Kandahar plus seven sound pothole-country stations (Avonlea W, Briercrest, Dafoe, Dirt Hills, Muenster, Wynyard E, Yorkton W); the step that lands it there is charging each station with the retrieval's own error, and the model, the better reference or the two references' mean keep a reference's error too (2, 2 and 4 of the eight), when triple collocation of station, retrieval and model on the tracking mornings separates each station's own error and puts five open-cropland stations among the eight.
lineage.answer: Re-install Swift Current E, Kindersley W, Davidson W, Watrous S, Melfort N, Pense, Kandahar and Spiritwood N in April 2027, in that order (own errors 0.048 to 0.034 m3/m3; ninth Craik E 0.024)

lineage.architecture: v2 (architecture 2, final form after hardening loop 1)
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-11 at hardening loop 2 phase A: round 4 landed the golden eight on its own independence check (a second station of the cell in every multi-station cell) and no loop-2 rung was found outside a third independence layer
lineage.driver: Each unit's own random error against a signal nothing observes decides the ranking, and the two comparators that could separate it share an input in one region, so their errors co-vary there and the standard three-way covariance separation charges that region's units with the comparators' shared error; a fourth series independent of both, a second unit observing the same signal, separates each unit's error where the shared input bites, and the three-way answer misses the right set by three swaps.
lineage.driver_concrete: The spring crew can re-install eight of the network's 56 stations, ranked on each station's own random error against its satellite cell's true soil moisture (NS-03 s.2.1); the Ninox retrieval and the PLSM model both take soil texture from the same 1:1 million provincial soil map, which carries the heavy clay plains as clay loam, so over the two clay cells their errors co-vary and triple collocation of station, retrieval and model charges Balgonie S, Grand Coulee and Regina W with the products' shared error; collocating with the morning retrieval and a second station in the same cell (the model only in the three single-station cells, none on the clay) returns Spiritwood N, Swift Current E, Kindersley W, Davidson W, Pense, Watrous S, Melfort N and Kandahar.
lineage.stump: A competent solver who reads NS-03 s.2.1 as asking for each station's own error separates it by triple collocation of the station, the morning retrieval and the PLSM model and re-installs Balgonie S, Grand Coulee and Regina W in place of Watrous S, Melfort N and Kandahar; the step that lands it there is treating the retrieval and the model as independent references over the heavy clay plains, where both take their texture from the same provincial soil map and err together, which a second station in the cell separates.
lineage.answer: Re-install Spiritwood N, Swift Current E, Kindersley W, Davidson W, Pense, Watrous S, Melfort N and Kandahar in the April 2027 window, largest tracking error first.
